# Wiring Through Firewall Grommet

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Remove fuse box cover, nick grommet with razor blade, and apply white petroleum lube. [t4]

## Tools

- Razor blade [t4]
- Petroleum lube [t4]

## Tips & gotchas

- Apply white petroleum lube to reduce drag on wires while pulling them through the firewall grommet. [t4]
